description: This file defines the 'Topic' model class within the Opencart admin CMS module. It provides methods for creating, reading, updating, and deleting topic records in the database, as well as managing associated descriptions, stores, layouts, and SEO URLs.

classes.name: Topic
classes.description: Represents the CMS Topic model class with methods to manage topic data within the database, including CRUD operations, descriptions, store assignments, layouts, and SEO URLs.

methods.name: addTopic
methods.description: Creates a new topic record in the database using provided data, including descriptions, store associations, SEO URLs, and layouts. Returns the new topic ID.

methods.name: editTopic
methods.description: Updates an existing topic record and its associated descriptions, stores, SEO URLs, and layouts based on provided data.

methods.name: deleteTopic
methods.description: Deletes a topic record and all its associated descriptions, store links, SEO URLs, and layouts from the database.

methods.name: getTopic
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information of a specific topic by its ID, utilizing caching for optimization.

methods.name: getTopics
methods.description: Fetches a list of topics from the database with optional filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalTopics
methods.description: Returns the total count of topic records in the database with optional filters.

methods.name: addDescription
methods.description: Adds a description record for a topic in a specific language.

methods.name: deleteDescriptions
methods.description: Deletes all description records for a given topic.

methods.name: deleteDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes all descriptions associated with a specific language ID.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Retrieves all description records for a specific topic.

methods.name: getDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Fetches all descriptions for a particular language ID.

methods.name: addStore
methods.description: Associates a topic with a store.

methods.name: deleteStores
methods.description: Removes all store associations for a topic.

methods.name: getStores
methods.description: Retrieves a list of store IDs associated with a topic.

methods.name: addLayout
methods.description: Associates a topic with a specific layout for a store.

methods.name: deleteLayouts
methods.description: Deletes all layout associations for a topic.

methods.name: deleteLayoutsByLayoutId
methods.description: Deletes all topic layout associations for a specific layout ID.

methods.name: getLayouts
methods.description: Retrieves layout associations for a topic.

methods.name: getTotalLayoutsByLayoutId
methods.description: Returns the count of topic layouts associated with a particular layout ID.
